title: The perfect side table.
text: The perfect side table.. What a beautiful piece of furniture!  Magazine rack in back, built in power source, slide out cup and snack tray...what more can you ask for? I like it so much that I bought another for a night table.  It’s the perfect side table.

product_metadata.title: Signature Design by Ashley Laflorn Chairside End Table with USB Ports & Outlets - Dark Brown
features: Made of veneers, wood and manmade wood
Pull-out drink tray with remote cubby
Outlet area 11 1/8"W x 4 1/2"D x 2 3/4"H; Pull-out tray 9 3/4"W x 13 3/4"D x 2 1/4"H; Door opening 9"W x 13 3/4"D x 16"H; Back storage opening 10"W x 15"D x 14 1/4"H.
description: If you are looking for that perfect addition that is sure to enhance any living area then look no further than the style and function of the Power Chairside End Table collection. So much form and function in a beautifully compact piece of furniture. This richly styled chairside end table puts it all within reach, including a flip-up top panel revealing a power port—perfect for keeping your phone or laptop charged. Hidden twin cup holders and interior shelved storage are also a welcome surprise.
